data.one_liner: Read and set system network proxy info from native on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin to read system proxy settings from native code and apply them in Dart. It configures HttpOverrides.global with either the system proxy or a custom proxy and supports auto-updates when the system proxy changes.
use_when: You need to read system proxy settings on Android and iOS.
You want your app to automatically react when the system proxy changes.
avoid_when: You do not need network proxy configuration or system proxy detection.
strengths: Reads system proxy settings on both Android and iOS.
Provides automatic updates when the system proxy changes via callback.
Allows forcing a custom proxy for debugging.
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platform support.
Documentation does not detail additional platform setups.
data.setup_notes: Add native_flutter_proxy to pubspec.yaml and initialize the reader and callback in main.
